The '''grandfather''' of [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Tyrak]] was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] member of the [[Tyrak lineage]]. Tyrak's grandfather [[Marriage/Legends|married]] his niece, [[Tyrak's aunt]], continuing the tradition of incestuous marriages in the family.
